review_evidence: README identifies a Lean 4 formalization of Tao's Analysis I, rebuilding the development from Peano axioms without importing Mathlib inside the main modules and including end-of-section exercises.

The primary corpus contains natural-number and set-theory chapters together with separate solution modules; those solution files are formal proofs of textbook exercises and therefore first-class mathematical prior art.
No chapter/solution module satisfies a no-content or duplication invariant, and the Lean lakefile alone does not justify a path-wide exclusion under FILTER-008.
summary: Retain the Tao Analysis I chapter formalizations and exercise-solution proofs.
